ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Execution GCC  - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the "gcc" utility to execute a shell. Such behavior may be associated with privilege escalation, unauthorized command execution, or to break out from restricted environments.

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\/c89$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/c99$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/gcc$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-wrapper.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/bash\\,\\-s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/dash\\,\\-s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/fish\\,\\-s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/sh\\,\\-s.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/bin\\/zsh\\,\\-s.*")))
